answer: One defense is a crystal spiral audited by a public beacon: every agent's history is a crystal, an append-only hash-chained log of work and endorsements winding back through past epochs like a spiral. Each epoch a public randomness beacon picks one random turn of the spiral for deep audit, and peers verify the endorsements there came from distinct, real agents. A sybil farmer must forge a full-length crystal for every fake, with real endorsements at every turn, never knowing which turn the beacon will check, while one honest agent simply keeps its one crystal growing.
